title: How to Build a Chrome Extension With AI
summary: Build a Chrome extension with AI — including the backend. Blink handles the database, auth, and API so you ship a real extension, not just a demo.
body_markdown: Manifest V3 (MV3) is the current Chrome extension standard. Google stopped accepting Manifest V2 submissions in June 2025. Your extension must use MV3. The main changes from V2: background pages became service workers (which sleep when inactive), network request modification uses a declarative API, and Content Security Policy is stricter. Any AI-generated code should default to V3 — verify` "manifest_version": 3` in the generated` manifest.json` .
